questions.question: Identify four (4) types of dairy milk that is used to prepare espresso coffee and explain their characteristics.
guidance: It contains 3.5% – 4% fat, which is an ideal amount to support the perfect balance of flavour, microfoam texture and consistency. Full-fat milk can take longer to steam and froth than other milk products because of its high fat content. The coffee beverages mixed with full-fat milk have a fuller texture and a sweeter taste.

It contains 1% - 2% milk fat. Low-fat milk has slightly more protein per cup than full-fat milk. It produces similar quality and consistency microfoam as full fat milk and takes less time to steam. There is no significant difference in taste and flavour when using low-fat milk, but it has lighter mouthfeel.
Skim milk does not contain any fat and gives a larger volume and denser foam than any other type of milk. When steamed, skim milk tastes sweeter, but is not as flavourful as other types of milk.
Lactose-free milk – suitable for those who are lactose intolerant

questions.question: What are the two (2) main species of coffee?
answer_points: Arabica Coffee
Robusta Coffee

questions.question: What are the primary characteristics of the two main species of coffee?
guidance: Arabica – sweeter, more complex, and subtle flavours, such as chocolatey, fruity, and nutty
Robusta – high in caffeine, stronger tasting, and more bitter
answer_points: Arabica – sweeter, more complex, and subtle flavours, such as chocolatey, fruity, and nutty
Robusta – high in caffeine, stronger tasting, and more bitter

answer_points: Acidulous
Light-bodied
Very aromatic

questions.question: What are three (3) primary characteristics of coffee beans from Indonesia?
answer_points: Earthy

questions.question: What is meant by ‘single origin coffee beans?
guidance: Beans grown by a single grower in a specific region of a given country.
answer_points: Beans grown by a single grower in a specific region of a given country.

questions.question: What is meant by a coffee ‘blend’?
guidance: The ratio of different types of coffee beans mixed together. The different types of coffee can be from different countries and regions.
answer_points: The ratio of different types of coffee beans mixed together. The different types of coffee can be from different countries and regions.

questions.question: What is meant by the ‘degree of roast’ in relation to coffee beans?
guidance: The length of time it has been roasted.
answer_points: The length of time it has been roasted.

questions.question: Are the ‘American’ and ‘Cinnamon’ roasts a light roast or a dark roast?
